I'm Renting Equipment for My First Short. Need Some Tips.

I would strongly consider getting something other than BMPC if you can. I used one a few times and it was a nightmare. The battery life was garbage. The files were huge. The ISO performance was very poor. The camera would lie about the length of battery it had left. The camera would often forget your settings making you navigate clunky menus to turn focus peaking back on. That said, when the conditions are right it makes a great image, but there's plenty of cameras that do just as well and aren't complete fucking Divas about it.

If you're not familiar with the camera get something more user friendly. I personally find Canon DSLRs are pretty user friendly as is the bigger black magic Cinema cameras. An A7s might also be a good option for it's insane ISO performance will be a lot more forgiving to poor lighting or lighting with existing light and practicals.

Ditch that Microphone as well. You're not doing yourself any favors by getting a little mic that goes into camera pre-amps. At the very least get a real shotgun mic and an H4n. If that's outside the budget just get the H4n and use it on a stick like it was a boom pole. The MKE400 is good for getting natural sound and yea it's a little better than nothing, it's probably not worth paying money for and it's definitely not something I would use as anything more than scratch audio for synching your real audio. Hell an Iphone tapped to a stick would probably produce better results.
